title: Merlin's GemBot – Automated Faceting Machine Tutorial
description: Complete step-by-step tutorial for setting up and operating the GemBot automated gemstone faceting machine

scenes.title: Opening
scenes.description: Fade in from black with title card
scenes.narration: Welcome to the Gem Bot tutorial. In this video, we'll walk through setup, operation, and maintenance to get you faceting beautiful gemstones.
scenes.cameraMovement: Slow zoom-in on the Gem Bot machine image, centered

scenes.title: Safety Instructions
scenes.description: Show safety equipment and workspace setup
scenes.narration: Always wear protective equipment and keep your workspace clean. Never leave the Gem Bot unattended during operation. Safety is paramount.
scenes.cameraMovement: Pan left to right across safety gear with close-ups

scenes.title: Components Overview
scenes.narration: Your Gem Bot package includes dop sticks for holding stones, diamond grit wheels for cutting, polishing compounds, a polishing wheel, and a touchscreen controller for precise automation.
scenes.cameraMovement: Quick cuts with close-up zooms on each component

scenes.title: Setup - Assembly
scenes.narration: Lift carefully from the aluminum frame rails. Secure the upper unit with the supplied screws. The machine consists of an upper cutting unit and a lower base with motor assembly.
scenes.cameraMovement: Tracking shot from side as two people lift the unit with transitions to close-ups

scenes.title: Setup - Cable Connections
scenes.narration: Connect the seven labeled cables: angle motor for tilt control, limit switches for safety, X and Y motors for positioning, index motor for stone rotation, power supply, and water pump connection.
scenes.cameraMovement: Zoom-in on each connector as they are plugged in with labels visible

scenes.title: Power On & Calibration
scenes.narration: Turn on the main power switch. Run a switch test to ensure all limit switches are functioning properly. Set the 90-degree calibration screw so the dop stick lies flat on the master lap. This ensures accurate stone positioning.
scenes.cameraMovement: Close-up of power switch, then overhead shot of calibration

scenes.title: Water Drip System Test
scenes.narration: Test the water drip system. Ensure water flows correctly from the reservoir to the wheel and returns without leaks. The water keeps the wheel cool and removes stone dust during cutting.
scenes.cameraMovement: Slow-motion close-up of water dripping onto wheel

scenes.title: Mounting the Gemstone
scenes.narration: Attach your gemstone securely to the dop stick using our precision mounting system. The gemstone must be centered and balanced for optimal cutting results. Insert the dop stick into the chuck and tighten securely.
scenes.cameraMovement: Zoom-in on mounting, then rotating view of inserted stone

scenes.title: Touchscreen Interface
scenes.narration: Use the touchscreen to select your gemstone design. We have hundreds of pre-programmed cutting patterns. Choose your desired shape, facet number, and cutting style. The Gem Bot will automate the cutting process with precision.
scenes.cameraMovement: Screen capture animation of selecting shape and design options

scenes.title: Manual Controls
scenes.narration: Manual controls allow precise adjustments for custom cuts. Control the stone angle with smooth increments, adjust X and Y positioning for exact placement, and manually rotate the stone index. These controls give you creative freedom.
scenes.cameraMovement: Split-screen showing touchscreen controls and corresponding machine movements

scenes.title: Automated Cutting Process
scenes.narration: Once you start the cutting sequence, the Gem Bot takes over. It precisely positions the stone against the appropriate wheel, maintains optimal pressure, and controls rotation speed. Watch as your gemstone transforms into a brilliant faceted work of art.
scenes.cameraMovement: Wide shot of machine, then close-ups of cutting action

scenes.title: Polishing Process
scenes.narration: Finally, polish your gemstone to achieve maximum brilliance and clarity. The polishing wheel with specialized compounds removes any scratches from the cutting process, creating a mirror-like finish that makes your stone sparkle.
scenes.cameraMovement: Close-up of gemstone against polishing wheel with light reflection

scenes.title: Quality Inspection
scenes.narration: Remove your finished gemstone and inspect it under proper lighting. Look for sharp facets, even polish, and excellent light reflection. Use our included magnification tools to verify quality. Your Gem Bot creates museum-quality cuts.
scenes.cameraMovement: Rotating gemstone under bright light with magnified inspection

scenes.title: Maintenance & Care
scenes.narration: Maintain your Gem Bot with these simple steps. Clean the wheels after each use. Replace water regularly. Store tools in the provided organizer. Perform monthly calibration checks. Proper maintenance keeps your machine cutting beautifully for years.
scenes.cameraMovement: Step-by-step demonstration of each maintenance task

scenes.title: Tips & Best Practices
scenes.narration: Pro tip: Start with softer stones as you learn. Use consistent pressure for even facets. Keep your workspace well-lit. Don't rush the polishing stage. Always reference the stone before and after for comparison. Join our community online to share your creations.
scenes.cameraMovement: Montage of best practices with examples

scenes.title: Troubleshooting Quick Reference
scenes.narration: If you experience any issues, reference our quick troubleshooting guide. Most problems have simple solutions. If wheels aren't grinding, check alignment. If water won't flow, check the pump. For detailed support, visit our online help center.
scenes.cameraMovement: Text-based guide with visual solutions

scenes.title: Your First Cut - Guided Example
scenes.description: Complete walkthrough of one cutting cycle
scenes.narration: Let's walk through your first cut together. We're using a beautiful piece of quartz. Select the brilliant cut pattern. Mount the stone securely. Verify calibration. Start the sequence. Watch as your Gem Bot creates perfect facets. Now polish to brilliance. Beautiful!
scenes.cameraMovement: Continuous action from mounting through polishing

scenes.title: Advanced Features
scenes.narration: Your Gem Bot has advanced features for experienced users. Custom design import allows you to create unique patterns. Preset save stores your favorite settings. Real-time analytics shows cutting statistics. These tools help you master precision faceting.
scenes.cameraMovement: Screen demonstrations of advanced menus

scenes.title: Closing & Resources
scenes.narration: You now have the knowledge to operate your Gem Bot professionally. Visit our website for more tutorials, design templates, and community features. Practice regularly and you'll master this amazing technology.
scenes.cameraMovement: Montage of beautiful finished gemstones

scenes.title: Final Shot - Closing
scenes.description: Fade to finished gemstone sparkling under light
scenes.narration: With Gem Bot, faceting becomes precise, automated, and efficient. Thank you for watching. Now go create something beautiful.
scenes.cameraMovement: Slow rotation shot around a brilliant gemstone with lighting effects
